retrieval_skill.name: windowed_mechanism_retrieval
retrieval_skill.description: Retrieve documented future-window interventions or operating regimes that can shift the forecast target, prioritizing causal mechanism evidence over superficial correlation.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When forecasting a time series and public evidence may describe an intervention, capacity change, operating regime, or other latent process within the forecast window.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search using the target type, location or system context, forecast-window boundaries, and terms for level changes, operational events, interventions, or demand shifts; retain claims that specify both the causal mechanism and its temporal overlap with the forecast horizon.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Use only provenance-backed evidence whose stated event window overlaps the forecast window and whose mechanism directly affects the target; preserve exact-quote requirements, reject temporally ambiguous or merely correlated claims, and do not extrapolate beyond the documented scope.

decision_skill.name: verified_event_override
decision_skill.description: Override persistence-based forecasts when verified, temporally aligned causal evidence establishes a directional level shift during the forecast horizon.
decision_skill.applicability: When a default forecast assumes local-level persistence but credible evidence identifies a target-relevant event or regime change within the future window.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Select the evidence-adjusted candidate when the claim is verified, causally linked to the target, temporally overlapping the forecast horizon, and directly inconsistent with persistence; limit the adjustment to the supported interval and scope.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not apply when provenance is weak, the evidence falls outside the forecast window, the mechanism-target link is indirect, the effect direction or scope is unclear, or the adjustment would require unsupported extrapolation.
